summary.en: Read and write Feishu / Lark as the signed-in person, not as a bot, through an openlark-gateway you run yourself.
summary.zh-CN: 通过你自己运行的 openlark-gateway，以登录者本人而不是机器人的身份读写飞书。

hint.en: wss://… or https://…; ws:// and http:// only for a gateway on this machine
hint.zh-CN: wss://… 或 https://…；ws:// 和 http:// 只用于本机上的网关

hint.en: Created with `openlark-gateway cred create`; its scopes decide what Steve may do
hint.zh-CN: 用 `openlark-gateway cred create` 创建；它的权限范围决定 Steve 能做什么
